dataDeletion.title: Data deletion
dataDeletion.doneBody: Your local practice data was reset.
dataDeletion.guestBody: In guest mode, practice history, scores, and session records are kept on this device. Without creating an account, cloud account data may not be created.
dataDeletion.localResetIntro: The button below only resets local practice data on this device. It is not account deletion and does not cancel a store subscription.
dataDeletion.requestBody: For an account and data deletion request, email Voira Support ({{email}}). Include the email you use in the app. Subject: Voira Data Deletion Request. This is not one-tap automatic deletion; your request is verified and then processed.
dataDeletion.afterVerifyBody: After a verified deletion request, data linked to your account is deleted or de-identified, subject to legal / security / fraud-prevention / transaction-record obligations. This may include account data and, if stored, progress, vocabulary notebook, and analysis history.
dataDeletion.inAppDeleteBody: To delete a signed-in account, use Profile → Delete account. After you confirm, account deletion completes in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Voira (“Voira”, “app”, “we”) — Last updated: July 2026
privacy.introBody: Voira provides English speaking, shadowing, pronunciation practice, a vocabulary notebook, progress tracking, and SpeakPlus premium access. This summary explains how data is handled in the app. The full policy is on the web page.
privacy.audioBody: Microphone permission is requested only when you want to record. Your recording is sent to the Voira server for analysis. Microsoft Azure Speech may be used for pronunciation assessment. When the backend is enabled, OpenAI may process your recorded audio for speech-to-text/transcription and AI coach feedback. We do not use recordings to build a public profile or sell voice data.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell personal data. We share or process data with service providers only as needed to operate the app. Disclosure may occur when required by law or for security.
privacy.childrenBody: Voira is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If a parent or guardian believes a child provided data, they can contact us.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Voira language practice app — Last updated: July 2026
terms.acceptBody: Voira is developed by StudioWebia. By downloading or using Voira, you accept these Terms of Use. If you do not accept them, do not use the app.
terms.useBody: Voira offers English speaking / shadowing practice, pronunciation feedback, vocabulary tools, and progress tracking. You agree to use the app only for lawful personal learning purposes.
terms.accountBody: If you create an account, you are responsible for keeping your credentials private and for activity on your account. Guest use may offer limited persistence; an account helps protect progress and SpeakPlus access.
terms.scoresBody: Voira provides practice and feedback; it does not guarantee a language certificate, medical advice, or official accreditation. Scores are estimates and may vary with microphone quality, accent, background noise, connectivity, and speech clarity.
terms.acceptableBody: Do not abuse the app, reverse engineer it beyond legal limits, overload the backend with automated requests, bypass limits/paywalls, or submit illegal or harassing content.
terms.ipBody: App content, design, lessons, and branding belong to Voira and StudioWebia (except third-party marks). You are responsible for content you record; you grant a limited permission to process audio and text solely to provide app features.
terms.disclaimerBody: Voira is provided “as is.” To the extent allowed by law, liability for indirect damages and learning outcomes is disclaimed. Disputes are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye (mandatory consumer protections reserved).

about.title: About Voira
about.subtitle: Speak, get analysis, improve.
about.whatBody: Voira is an AI speaking coach that analyzes your English, measures pronunciation, and helps you improve weak words with clear explanations.
about.versionBody: Speech analysis is based on word matching, Azure pronunciation assessment, and fluency measures. Scores are guidance only and are not an official language certificate.

billing.manageText: You can manage your subscription from your {{storeName}} account.
billing.manageCancelText: You can manage or cancel your subscription in your {{storeName}} account settings.
billing.premiumCancelNote: You can manage or cancel your subscription in your {{storeName}} account settings. Subscriptions renew automatically.
billing.aboutSpeakPlusBody: SpeakPlus is an in-app subscription for premium lesson packs and advanced feedback. Payments are managed through your {{storeName}} account. You can restore purchases from Profile or the paywall.
billing.termsSpeakPlusBody: SpeakPlus subscriptions are billed through {{storeName}}. Price and renewal terms are shown before purchase. Cancellation and refunds follow store policies. Deleting the app or requesting data deletion does not cancel the subscription; manage or cancel it in your {{storeName}} account settings.
billing.privacyCollectedBody: Account details (email, auth/user ID), profile and progress (lesson progress, streak, practice stats, saved words), audio recordings only when you record, pronunciation analysis results (scores, words, fluency/accuracy/completeness, etc.), SpeakPlus subscription/entitlement status ({{storeName}} / RevenueCat), and app version plus basic diagnostics.
billing.privacyThirdPartyBody: Supabase (auth / data), RevenueCat (subscription entitlement), {{storeName}} (payments), Microsoft Azure Speech (speech recognition and pronunciation assessment), OpenAI (speech-to-text/transcription and AI coach feedback when backend is enabled), Render (backend hosting). These services process data only as needed for app functionality.
billing.privacyPaymentsBody: Subscription payments are managed through your {{storeName}} account. Voira does not collect or store credit/debit card numbers. You can manage or cancel your subscription in {{storeName}} account settings. SpeakPlus access is managed via RevenueCat and store entitlement status.
billing.privacyRetentionBody: Local data may remain until deleted on your device or the app is removed. Account/progress/purchase records may be kept as needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, prevent abuse, or manage subscription access. For account and data deletion, contact Voira Support; subscription cancellation is separate ({{storeName}}). See the Data Deletion page for details.
billing.dataDeletionLocalResetMessage: This only deletes practice history, scores, and daily session records on this device. It is not an account deletion request. Profile preferences are kept. It does not cancel an active subscription.
billing.dataDeletionSubscriptionNote: Deleting your app account or app data does not cancel an active SpeakPlus subscription. To stop billing, cancel the subscription in your {{storeName}} account settings.
billing.dataDeletionSpeakPlusNote: Deleting your app account or app data does not cancel an active SpeakPlus subscription. To stop SpeakPlus, cancel it in your {{storeName}} account settings.
billing.dataDeletionMayRemainBody: {{storeName}} / RevenueCat transaction or entitlement records, anonymized logs, and data that remains only on your device (until app data is cleared or the app is removed).
billing.accountDeletionSubscriptionWarning: Deleting your account does not automatically cancel your subscription. You can manage an active subscription in your {{storeName}} account settings.
billing.accountDeletionConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and personal data in Voira. Deleting your account does not automatically cancel your subscription. You can manage an active subscription in your {{storeName}} account settings.
